name: multi-doc-workbench
description: Multi-Document Intelligence Workbench: upload documents, run an analysis prompt, get structured, source-cited insights.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mdw/server" "npm run dev -w @mdw/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mdw/shared && npm run build -w @mdw/server && npm run build -w @mdw/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mdw/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mdw/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
